preconditions.description: n is a multiple of 4 and within the range 4 to 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in grid)
postconditions.description: The grid is an n x n matrix.

postconditions.expression: set(range(n * n)) == set(num for row in grid for num in row)
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to n^2 - 1 appear exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(row_xor == col_xor for row_xor in row_xors for col_xor in col_xors)
postconditions.description: The XOR of all elements in each row and each column is the same.
